Lemma
[Doubling-time estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0260 1. ch14:14.6\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

If a complete bounded-curvature Ricci flow satisfies $|\operatorname {Rm}(g(0))|\le K$, then $|\operatorname {Rm}(g(t))|\le 2K$ for $0\le t\le (16K)^{-1}$.
Proof

\sketch The curvature evolution and Kato’s inequality give, in the barrier sense, $(\partial _t-\Delta )|\operatorname {Rm}|\le 8|\operatorname {Rm}|^2$. The maximum principle therefore compares $u(t)=\sup _M|\operatorname {Rm}(g(t))|$ with the solution of $v'=8v^2$, $v(0)=K$. Thus $u(t)\le K/(1-8Kt)$, which is at most $2K$ on the stated interval.

□
